evidence.title: Scala Data Centers Portfolio
evidence.excerpt: Scala's current portfolio places SFORPF01 in the Under construction section, identifies the Praia do Futuro campus in Fortaleza, and reports 7.2 MW of IT capacity.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 610118-byte content-decoded official HTML response body
metadata.under_construction_definition_as_reporte: Ongoing Civil Works, Installation and Commissioning Phases, among others.
metadata.physical_status_scope: The current first-party portfolio explicitly places this exact facility card inside Under construction and defines that section as physical civil works, installation, or commissioning. No narrower construction substage is inferred.
metadata.currentness_scope: This is a present-tense portfolio classification observed on the response date, so it supports under construction as of 2026-07-21. The older start-up year is not treated as completion or operation evidence.
metadata.capacity_scope: The card explicitly labels 7.2 MW as IT capacity. It is normalized once as design critical IT capacity because the page does not establish installed, energized, available, loaded, or measured capacity.
metadata.portfolio_guardrail: The page-level 100+ MW operational IT, 900+ MW under-construction-and-future, portfolio PUE below 1.4, and WUE zero statements are aggregates or portfolio claims and are not transferred to SFORPF01.
metadata.forecast_guardrail: The reported 2025 start-up year is stale relative to the live under-construction classification and creates no completion, commissioning, energization, or operation observation.
metadata.identity_guardrail: SFORPF01 is one facility project at the Praia do Futuro campus. Other operational, under-construction, in-development, planned, or substation cards are not merged, counted, or assigned to this project.
metadata.role_guardrail: Publisher identity alone creates no normalized owner, operator, developer, landlord, tenant, customer, user, contractor, investor, or utility role.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from an all-rights-reserved operator portfolio page; the page and publisher media are not redistributed.
metadata.capture_guardrail: The response body, raw headers, and curl writeout are hash-bound but are not retained in the repository artifact.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Publisher images, maps, satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, and analyst geolocation do not contribute to a normalized claim.

evidence.title: Fortaleza municipal SFORPF01 surveyed site plan
evidence.attribution: Prefeitura de Fortaleza - SEUMA; Scala Data Centers
evidence.excerpt: The official municipal planning file identifies Praia do Futuro SFORPF01 and publishes four surveyed SIRGAS 2000 boundary vertices.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 2965297-byte official two-page PDF response body
metadata.uncertainty_scope: Conservative analyst envelope for PDF transcription, CRS interpretation, and transformation. It is not a publisher accuracy specification.
metadata.precision_guardrail: Millimeter-formatted source vertices are retained as text, but the normalized WGS84 point and ring are rounded to six decimals and carry a five-meter uncertainty envelope. Decimal representation is not accuracy.
metadata.geometry_scope: The project geometry is the surveyed SFORPF01 property boundary shown in the municipal planning file, not a building footprint or full future Praia do Futuro campus boundary. The campus stores only the same point as an anchor because SFORPF01 is explicitly parented to that curated campus.
metadata.claim_guardrail: This evidence changes only coordinate snapshot fields. It creates no lifecycle, capacity, operator, owner, workload, type, energy, or current-status claim.
metadata.raw_capture_guardrail: The all-rights-reserved PDF, headers, curl writeout, extracted text, and renders are hash-bound but are not redistributed in the repository artifact.
metadata.retrieval_time_basis: local filesystem completion mtime of the exact byte-identical refetch; the server Date corroborates transfer start but is not retrieved_at
metadata.server_date_guardrail: The server Date is retained only as server_response_http_date_as_reported; retrieved_at is the later local completed-capture timestamp.

capacities.notes: Current first-party IT-capacity card value, retained at design stage. It is not installed, energized, operationally available, current load, gross facility demand, grid connection, generation, consumption, annual energy, or measured PUE.
